clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter's long hours away from home, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, Walter and June's rows over money for trees, and June's joining the church choir with her letters thinning out; these shifts settle by September 1953 when her anxiety eased and she took up the choir.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the frost took the crop and the bank called the loan: Walter's drinking heavily, his conflict with Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian's overfunctioning as they took over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks that winter, and your bedwetting in April 1969; Walter's functioning rose when he stopped drinking and took pruning work in October 1969, and this settles the period.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job loss in February 1975: Glen's functioning dropped as he sat in the truck for hours out of work, he and Marian's loud fights at night over money, Marian's overfunctioning as she took a second job at night, your weight loss and stopped eating that summer, your distance from your mother as you kept to your room, Walter's drinking again after six years off it, and your functioning rose in June 1976 when you ate again and made the track team.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into your house in January 1990: your clashes with her over the children's bedtimes and meals, your distance from Hollis as he worked late and kept out of the rows, Hollis's toward move to his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma's overfunctioning as she took over Lily's care, your eczema flaring on both hands, your rows with Hollis most nights, and your eczema clearing over the summer of 1991 after Wilma moved to a flat in town in June.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess's drinking most nights from October 1996: your anxiety rose as you phoned her every night worried for her, Marian and Tess's overfunctioning as Marian paid Tess's rent and kept Jesse most weekends, Tess and Rick's shouting matches with Rick sleeping at his brother's for a month, and Tess's functioning rose in June 1997 when she stopped drinking and went to meetings twice a week.
